items.story:

By studying 21 rare “extreme debris disks” around young stars, researchers found that their dust can reveal the scale and intensity of planetary collisions.

items.headline: Scientists changed how zoo lions eat. Their wild side came out
items.teaser: Giving zoo lions whole carcasses on a feast-and-fast schedule appears to bring out more natural behavior. The lions spent nearly three ti…
items.story:
Giving zoo lions whole carcasses on a feast-and-fast schedule appears to bring out more natural behavior. The lions spent nearly three times longer feeding, engaged in more tearing and manipulating of food, and rested more heavily after meals. Their activity then increased gradually during the fasting period, closely resembling the rhythm seen in wild lions.

Reporting by Science Daily. Read the full story at the original publication.

items.headline: Physicists just found the ‘ghost’ of superconductivity
items.teaser: Physicists have found striking evidence for an unusual form of superconducting behavior in uranium ditelluride, where electron pairs orga…
items.story:
Physicists have found striking evidence for an unusual form of superconducting behavior in uranium ditelluride, where electron pairs organize into rippling patterns called pair density waves. Even more surprisingly, these patterns appear to survive after ordinary superconductivity disappears, suggesting that the electron pairs responsible for superconductivity may begin forming before the material actually becomes superconducting.

Reporting by Science Daily. Read the full story at the original publication.

items.story: തായ് യുവതിയെ വിവാഹം ചെയ്ത് 60 ലക്ഷം തട്ടി, പിന്നാലെ മുങ്ങി; പണം ചോദിച്ചപ്പോൾ മതം മാറാനാവശ്യപ്പെട്ടു, യുപി സ്വദേശിക്കെതിരേ കേസ് Mathrubhumiസമൂഹമാധ്യമത്തിലൂടെ പരിചയം, തായ്‌ലൻഡിലെത്തി വിവാഹം ചെയ്തു, പണം തട്ടി മുങ്ങി; യുവാവിനെ തേടി യുവതി ഇന്ത്യയിലേക്ക് Manorama Onlineതായ്‌ലാൻഡ് യുവതിയെ കബളിപ്പിച്ച് വിവാഹം കഴിച്ച് പണം തട്ടി; മതം മാറണമെന്ന് ആവശ്യം Kerala Kaumudiതായ് യുവതിയെ വിവാഹം കഴിച്ച് 60 ലക്ഷം തട്ടി; മതം മാറാന്‍ ആവശ്യപ്പെട്ട് ഉപദ്രവം, യു.പി സ്വദേശി അറസ്റ്റില്‍ C News Live

items.story: NASA’s James Webb Space Telescope is giving astronomers a glimpse of the kinds of violent collisions that may have shaped our own solar system, including the giant impact thought to have created the Moon. By studying 21 rare “extreme debris disks” around young stars, researchers found that their dust can reveal the scale and intensity of planetary collisions.

items.headline: Scientists changed how zoo lions eat. Their wild side came out
items.teaser: Giving zoo lions whole carcasses on a feast-and-fast schedule appears to bring out more natural behavior. The lions spent nearly three ti…
items.story: Giving zoo lions whole carcasses on a feast-and-fast schedule appears to bring out more natural behavior. The lions spent nearly three times longer feeding, engaged in more tearing and manipulating of food, and rested more heavily after meals. Their activity then increased gradually during the fasting period, closely resembling the rhythm seen in wild lions.

items.headline: Physicists just found the ‘ghost’ of superconductivity
items.teaser: Physicists have found striking evidence for an unusual form of superconducting behavior in uranium ditelluride, where electron pairs orga…
items.story: Physicists have found striking evidence for an unusual form of superconducting behavior in uranium ditelluride, where electron pairs organize into rippling patterns called pair density waves. Even more surprisingly, these patterns appear to survive after ordinary superconductivity disappears, suggesting that the electron pairs responsible for superconductivity may begin forming before the material actually becomes superconducting.
